cohort: 143 patients with placenta previa undergoing cesarean section between April 2006 and December 2018
finding: The combined use of Matsubara-Takahashi cervix-holding, intrauterine balloon, and uterine compression suture was associated with decreased postpartum hemorrhage in patients with placenta previa.
mod_finding: This study, which evaluated hemostatic procedures for postpartum hemorrhage in women with placenta previa, did not compare different modes of delivery.
